title: Hitting probability on a chain digraph
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $T$, consider the digraph on $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$ in which $i$ has an edge to every vertex $j$ that is $0$ or satisfies $j=i+1$. Starting at vertex $0$, the probability of hitting the target vertex $n$ within the recursively defined $T$-step process is at most $(T+1)/2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: The specified chain digraph on Fin(n+1).
The target vertex is n and the starting vertex is 0.
